newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs up on bullish press report.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs up on bullish press report.

text.p: Cortecs International Ltd jumped in active trading on Wednesday, bolstered by a press report that said Nomura advised clients to buy the stock ahead of a key trial data on treatment for osteoporosis, dealers said.
By 0757 GMT, the shares were up 19-1/2p, or 8.2 percent, to 256-1/2p.

The Daily Mail newspaper quoted Nomura analyst Nick Woolf as saying that if the efficacy demonstrated in Phase II trials last April can be repeated in Phase II/III, then submission for a Europoean licence and a multi-national partner could be secured within a few months.
His price target for the stock was over 400p, according to the report.
The analyst could not immediately be reached to comment. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
